sourceEvidence.technicalQualification: Original voice-free procedural composition (score declares voice=false). Part 1 is the first 49:00 of the preserved 48 kHz master re-encoded to the same AAC format as the other editions; Part 2 is the existing 60-minute core, verified to match the master's last 60 minutes at codec level. Compared with the Nicole edition's Part 1, the only differences are four bursts at 0:30, 2:50, 6:05 and 9:40 (her cues). Verified by bytes and signal comparison; no independent human A/B listening yet.
